note: Hand-picked tile colours (bg) for covers whose logo has a transparent border, keyed like data/atlas/atlas-covers.json. Only used when the border is transparent; a cover with an opaque border keeps its own edge colour. Pick a colour only when the logo itself (or the brand's official page) shows the logo on it, and never the logo's own lettering colour. Read by scripts/atlas/build_atlas_covers.mjs (scripts/atlas/lib/cover_colors.mjs).

line:beyblade:BX.why: Frame colour of the BX mark (official beginner guide shows the three line marks as coloured squares; the CX crop is already full pink, so BX / UX match it)

line:beyblade:UX.why: Frame colour of the UX mark (same as BX)

line:fate:NENDOROID.why: Orange panel of the Nendoroid logo; the white lettering stays readable on it

line:madoka:NENDOROID.why: Orange panel of the Nendoroid logo (same file as fate)

line:gundam:CHOGOKIN.why: Yellow panel of the 超合金 logo (TAMASHII NATIONS); the black and red parts read on it

line:gundam:FM.why: Black panel of the FULL MECHANICS logo with white lettering

line:pokemon:POKE_GASHAPON.why: gashapon.jp shows the red ガシャポン mark on white (the GUNDAM_MERCH gashapon cover is on white too)
